name: Golden Mirror
source:
As the "eldest daughter" of a low ranking aristocrat, Nicasio is sent to a noble family that worships one of the Old Ones—an Old One whose identity is unknown. He has no wish to become a bride, but arriving at the estate reveals quickly that something is wrong. Nicasio must determine one thing: to push and investigate or accept the fate penned for him and be buried with a name not his own.

[From [url=https://altairdelirio.itch.io/golden-mirror]itch.io[/url]]
